raw_snippet: On March 18, 2026, the Company announced the pricing of a private offering of $4.0 billion aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes, comprising $2.25 billion of 1.250% notes due 2031 and $1.75 billion of 2.625% notes due 2033. The offering closed on March 20, 2026.
note: Nebius has no delayed-draw or term-loan facility in its FY2025 20-F or Q2 2026 6-K; all debt is convertible notes. Coupon on the longer 2033 tranche; 2031 tranche 1.250%. Subsequent-events note of the 20-F.
